attempts.raw: {"risk": 4, "reason": "In LayerFilter, `_adminThemeService?.GetAdminThemeNameAsync()` returns null when IAdminThemeService isn't registered (e.g. Admin module disabled), and awaiting that null Task will throw a NullReferenceException on every request for any site using Layers without the Admin feature enabled."}

reason: In LayerFilter, `_adminThemeService?.GetAdminThemeNameAsync()` returns null when IAdminThemeService isn't registered (e.g. Admin module disabled), and awaiting that null Task will throw a NullReferenceException on every request for any site using Layers without the Admin feature enabled.
